name: Network Intrusion Detection Systems Benchmark
description: An evaluation suite comparing network intrusion detection systems across standard datasets and metrics to measure detection performance and false positive behavior.
evaluation_method: F1 score / detection (recall) and false positive rate; also ROC AUC commonly reported
general_score_metric: F1 score (commonly used alongside detection rate and false positive rate)
typical_sota_score: varies widely (commonly reported in the ~70–95% range depending on dataset and task)
reputation: Historically influential as a baseline evaluation suite for intrusion detection research, but many variants are considered outdated and have been criticized for dataset issues.
notes: Many classic NIDS datasets suffer from class imbalance, synthetic traffic and contamination issues; results are highly dataset-dependent and may not reflect real-world network conditions.
